dataset.name: DKRZ EERIE future ssp245, P1M mean, HEALPix level 7 (Zarr; from gridlook's shipped catalog)

left.label: warp: ortho-cog-viewer
left.note: rangefinder opens the store and refuses the variable: "pr: no 1D coordinate arrays for cell / time", after 404s on cell/.zarray and cell/zarr.json. There is no coordinate array because a HEALPix cell's position is implied by its index, level and scheme; the geometry is a recipe, not arrays, and the warp side only reads arrays. Plan: docs/rangefinder-healpix.md in this repo.

right.label: cell: gridlook
right.note: Loaded through gridlook.pages.dev until the vendored build is confirmed to reach this host from the sidebyside origin.

gap: The warp side has DGGS on the analysis side (trend.sst: S2 cells plus Parquet) and none on the rendering side; the cell side has DGGS on the rendering side (HEALPix via the Zarr DGGS convention) and nothing on the analysis side. Neither can draw the other's cells.
bridge: HEALPix has an inverse (lon/lat to cell id), so the warp side can sample it the way it samples an affine grid: view pixel centres to cell ids in one healpix-geo call, then index the chunk. No mesh needed. Plan in docs/rangefinder-healpix.md; S2 via the same geometry object brings trend.sst cells, making the page shared from both ends.
